name: Knight of Xoroth: Sacrificial Circle client patch drops the Hellfire Imp caster aura (#7607)
contract: Requires CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1. Raw Sacrificial Circle 805677 requires caster aura 805916 (Hellfire Imp) in Spell.dbc, which no imp applies in CoA; the server clears it (#1489) and checks the caster's own living imps instead. The client evaluates CasterAuraSpell against its own Spell.dbc, so the login SMSG_PATCH_SPELL stream (opcode 2346) must carry the 805677 row with numeric field 24 (CasterAuraSpell) equal to 0 and field 26 (ExcludeCasterAuraSpell) equal to 0. Runeshroud 500639 is the control proving the login patch stream is present. This verifies emitted client data; client rendering and input remain outside the native harness.

steps.label: The existing login spell patch stream reaches this session
Sacrificial Circle is included in the client patch stream
Sacrificial Circle no longer requires the Hellfire Imp caster aura on the client
Sacrificial Circle carries no excluded caster aura on the client
